title: The Autumn Wood
summary: Cut through Kagerou's clones with Asahi at your side.

lines: So this is the famous hunter. You're shorter than the stories.
Focus. There's chakra moving in the trees.
Clones. Dozens of them. Wind and fire, from the feel of it.
Then we cut through. {name}, take the centre. Asahi, try not to set the forest on fire.
Then try not to set it on lightning. I'll take the ridge.
The ridge was worse. Look what they were guarding.
Plans for... a dam? Out here?
The Old Dam in the Ashen Valley. Iwao is carving a seal array into it. Finished, it turns the whole valley into a ritual circle.
Then we knock his dam down. Metaphorically. Mostly.
